title: 2023 Panini Select - Concourse Black & Green Prizm Die-Cut #27 Mazi Smith (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select trading card features Mazi Smith, a rookie player from the Dallas Cowboys. The card is made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt. and a black and green die-cut prizm parallel/variety. It belongs to the base set and has the card number 27.

This original card is manufactured by Panini and is an excellent addition to any football fan's collection. The card is in standard size and is part of the National Football League (NFL) league. It is a great opportunity to own a piece of sports history, and it is a must-have for any fan of Mazi Smith or the Dallas Cowboys.
